headline: Become a Client-Ready Virtual Assistant in 7 Days
subheadline: Learn how to package your services, use AI to work faster, and land paid work—without guesswork.
description:
What This Course Covers

This intensive 7-day program transforms complete beginners into job-ready Virtual Assistants. You'll learn the exact systems, tools, and strategies top VAs use to land and retain high-paying clients.

🎯 Who This Is For

  • Anyone stuck in a 9-5 looking for freelance income
  • Stay-at-home parents wanting flexible remote work
  • Students seeking side income while studying
  • Career changers exploring digital opportunities
  • Beginners with zero VA experience

📚 Course Structure

Day 1: What Is a Virtual Assistant? Understand the business model, niches, pricing, and service packages that sell.
Day 2: AI for VAs - Master ChatGPT prompts and workflows that save hours.
Day 3: Content Creation - Blog writing, LinkedIn, TikTok & Facebook content strategies.
Day 4: Instagram Mastery - Algorithm secrets, engagement tactics, and growth strategies.
Day 5: Essential Digital Tools - Google Workspace, Canva, scheduling tools, and automation.
Day 6: Data & Analytics - Track performance, summarize insights with AI.
Day 7: Client Acquisition - Scripts, proposals, pricing, and retention strategies.

✅ What You Get

  • 7 full recorded masterclass sessions (9+ hours of content)
  • Ready-to-use templates, scripts, and proposals
  • Lifetime access to course materials and updates
  • Certificate of completion after final project
  • Community support and Q&A access
benefits: Master AI tools like ChatGPT to work 10x faster on client tasks
Build a professional VA portfolio even with zero experience
Learn proven client acquisition scripts and proposals that convert
Master Google Workspace, Canva, and scheduling tools
Create scroll-stopping content for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn & Facebook
Understand VA pricing, packages, and how to charge what you're worth
Get replays and templates you can use immediately
Earn your certificate and start landing clients within weeks
